t: High-performance, polymer-based grab adhesive for indoor and outdoor projects. Versatile and shock-resistant grab adhesive bonds most common building materials such as wood, metal, concrete, and plastic. Ideal for various applications like cladding and bathroom fixtures. Unsuitable for PE, PP, PTFE, acrylic, plasticized PVC, copper and brass.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Brickwork, Stone, Blockwork & Plasterboard
